question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**knowledge**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the mental, intellectual, emotional, and spiritual benefits of reading.
 
• The correct word should relate to the benefit of acquiring useful mental content and information, which is a primary outcome of reading.
 
• "**Knowledge**" fits perfectly as it refers to the information and understanding gained from reading.
 
• Other options, such as "**readiness**", "**employment**", and "**strategies**", do not align well with the idea of intellectual growth that reading fosters.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The habit of reading is highly advantageous to us intellectually, emotionally and spiritually. As one gets into the habit of reading, one gets mental satisfaction__. It helps us acquire **__knowledge__** and attain intellectual (3)_________. Reading takes away our (4)_________. Reading can bring (5)__________ in our sorrowful times and guide us in our duties.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Readiness**" refers to being prepared, but it does not fit the context of intellectual development from reading.
 
• "**Employment**" refers to work or occupation, which does not relate to the cognitive benefits of reading.
 
• "**Strategies**" refers to methods or plans, but it is not as fitting as "knowledge" in the context of the passage.
